body:
### Summary

It looks like 69c2b6993 introduced a change in the cache format without bumping the version e.g. it's still wheels-v6 and sdists-v9

This seems to cause issues mainly with locally built wheels that are cached, where if produced by uv 0.12 it creates e.g an Archive struct with 5 fields instead of 4, so when read by an older uv, it can't read it.

It fails with `Failed to deserialize cache entry array had incorrect length, expected 4`.

This doesn't seem to affect packages that are downloaded + editable installs as on an invlaid cache it just retries fetching the entry/rebuilding.




### Platform

Linux 4.18.0-553.8.1.el8_29.x86_64

### Version

uv 0.12.0

### Python version

Python 3.12
title: Backwards incompatible cache change in uv 0.12.0
